The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] had a relationship with the '''daughter''' of [[Jackson Farseeker]], a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. The union produced a daughter, [[Jill Farseeker|Jill]], but Garnet lost contact with the family. He would eventually travel with his daughter and her grandfather during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] aboard his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], ''[[Dorion Discus]]''.<ref name="RPG" />
